ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Program Vulnerable to Fraud?
ideas.description: An in-depth investigation into the Minnesota Medicaid program and potential vulnerabilities to fraud.
questions: What are the specific vulnerabilities in the Minnesota Medicaid program?

ideas.insight: The recent report revealing widespread billing issues in the Minnesota autism program suggests a deeper issue with program management and potential fraud.
